summary: ESG Investing for Pension Funds is the systematic integration of environmental, social, and governance factors into the investment decision-making process.
lede: ESG investing for pension funds turns broad commitments into practical portfolio discipline. This training develops the skills to assess ESG data and ratings, evaluate materiality, strengthen manager due diligence, and connect investment decisions with fiduciary oversight. You will work through policy controls, stewardship priorities, climate-related risk thinking, and reporting alignment with recognized frameworks. Practical outputs include an ESG investment policy draft, a stewardship action plan, a materiality matrix, and an ESG reporting outline designed for decisions made with imperfect information and limited internal capacity.
audienceIntro: This ESG investing for pension funds training is designed for professionals who already work with pension investment decisions, oversight, or sustainability reporting and need a practical way to connect ESG analysis to fiduciary action.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of pension fund investment processes, portfolio oversight, or investment governance. Familiarity with basic asset classes, risk terminology, and board or committee reporting is expected; no programming is required. Prior exposure to ESG concepts, responsible investment, or fiduciary oversight will help, but the course begins with a structured foundation and then moves into applied pension fund use cases.
